target.title: test: cover Android main activity lifecycle gates
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android `MainActivity` lifecycle wiring had little focused coverage around the gates that defer initial intents until ViewModel activation, route new intents after activation, and attach runtime UI/service side effects only once after runtime startup.

## Why This Change Was Made

This extracts the lifecycle decisions into small package-internal helpers and covers the urgent behavior without launching the full Compose Activity:

- initial intents are deferred until activation and consumed once
- newer intents received before activation replace the stale pending intent
- intents received after activation route immediately
- runtime UI attachment and foreground service start only once when runtime initialization becomes ready
- the native i18n inventory is synchronized after moving the `OPENCLAW` source line
- the reply-init concurrency fixture now waits for valid child-written JSON before parsing, matching the CI shard race observed while validating these Android+i18n changes

The Activity still owns the actual ViewModel, Compose, runtime UI, and service calls; the helpers only make the existing gating rules directly testable.

## User Impact

Future Android startup changes are less likely to drop assistant launch intents, replay stale intents, or duplicate runtime UI/service startup work around Activity lifecycle transitions. The related CI shard is also less likely to fail on a half-written readiness file while validating native app changes.

## Evidence

- `git diff --check`
- `node --import tsx scripts/native-app-i18n.ts check`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/config/sessions/session-accessor.reply-init-concurrency.test.ts --reporter=verbose`
- `cd apps/android && ./gradlew :app:testThirdPartyDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.MainActivityLifecycleTest`
- `cd apps/android && ./gradlew :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.MainActivityLifecycleTest`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` -> clean, no accepted/actionable findings
